cards.card_text: So these days are called Purim, from the word Pur, and because of the letter and everything they had seen and lived through, the Jews bind themselves to keep them.
cards.verse_text: Therefore these days are called Purim, from the word Pur.
cards.snippet: Therefore these days are called Purim, from the word Pur.

cards.card_text: The plan is for the days of Purim to fade from memory once the danger is long past.
cards.verse_text: These days should be remembered and celebrated by every generation, family, province, and city, so that these days of Purim should not fail to be observed among the Jews, nor should the memory of them fade from their descendants.

cards.card_text: She and Mordecai the Jew write with full authority to confirm this second letter about Purim.
cards.verse_text: So Queen Esther daughter of Abihail, along with Mordecai the Jew, wrote with full authority to confirm this second letter concerning Purim.
cards.snippet: …the Jew, wrote with full authority to confirm this second letter concerning Purim.

cards.card_text: Mordecai's letters let each city keep the days of Purim at whatever time it chooses.
cards.verse_text: in order to confirm these days of Purim at their appointed time, just as Mordecai the Jew and Queen Esther had established them and had committed themselves and their descendants to the times of fasting and lamentation.
cards.snippet: in order to confirm these days of Purim at their appointed time, just as Mordecai the Jew and Queen Esther…

cards.card_text: Esther's decree confirms the rules about Purim.
cards.verse_text: So Esther’s decree confirmed these regulations about Purim, which were written into the record.
cards.snippet: So Esther’s decree confirmed these regulations about Purim, which were written into the record.
